title: Sudoku Solver
prompt:
Create a function that solves a Sudoku puzzle. The function takes in a partially filled puzzle and fills in the missing numbers.
Sample Input: 5 3 0 | 6 0 0 | 0 9 8
6 0 0 | 1 9 5 | 0 0 0
0 9 8 | 0 0 0 | 0 6 0
Sample Output: 5 3 4 | 6 7 8 | 9 9 8
6 7 2 | 1 9 5 | 3 4 9
9 9 8 | 4 2 1 | 5 6 7
